name: spice-boiler-thermostat-deepseek-v4.1-flash-s1-r2-v2
prompt: Model an espresso machine's boiler in ngspice as an electrical analogue (heater, thermal mass, heat loss) with a thermostat that holds it between 92 and 96 °C, and simulate the first 20 minutes from cold. In a .control block, save the boiler temperature with wrdata to a .txt file so it can be plotted.

source.text:
* Espresso machine boiler - lumped thermal model as an electrical analogue
* Analogy: node voltage V(T) = temperature [degC], current = heat flow [W]
* Ambient is 20 V.  A capacitor on T is the thermal mass (J/K).
* A resistor T-amb is the heat loss to ambient (K/W).
* A gated current source is the heater (W); a switch gives thermostat
* hysteresis: heater ON when T < 92 C, OFF when T > 96 C.

Vamb   amb 0 dc 20
Rloss  T   amb 0.1
Cth    T   0   3000
.ic v(T)=20

* --- thermostat with hysteresis -------------------------------------
* ctrl = 100 - T.  Switch closes when ctrl > Vt+Vh = 8 (T < 92 C),
* opens when ctrl < Vt-Vh = 4 (T > 96 C).
Bctrl  ctrl 0 V = 100 - V(T)
Vsup   sup  0 dc 1
S1     gate sup ctrl 0 SWTH
Rgate  gate 0 1e6
* heater: 1200 W injected into the thermal node when gate = 1 V
Bheat  0 T I = 1200 * V(gate)

.model SWTH SW(Ron=1 Roff=1e12 Vt=6 Vh=2)

.tran 0.25 1200 uic

.control
run
wrdata boiler_temp.txt v(T)
.endc
.end
